items.rationale: Promote the normal Cremșnit round. A1–A7: the familiar named pastry and five ordinary food ingredients have independent recipe/recognition support; the target is new to Alchimie, with no adult framing, regional claim or synonym-as-seed shortcut. E1: Făină, Apă, Lapte, Vanilie and Zahăr are category-coherent, and every seed participates in the live sparse book. E2: four live productive openings include two intuitive ideas, flour+water→dough and milk+vanilla→vanilla cream. E3/E4: independently preparing dough and cream, then assembling them, gives an inferable three-action target; none of the ten seed pairs gives the answer directly. E5 and exact projection gate: the audit binds five recipe pairs, three routes, eight total concepts and one result per pair; every route has par three with minimum/mean edge strength 0.8, all bounds true and zero live opening failures. The dossier broad closure of 167 concepts and six broad openings is not the played recipe book: unrelated oil/biscuit/cake/ice-cream branches are excluded. The same final proposed graph was independently exercised with ten opening probes and three perfect private route/resume/repeat journeys; all won at 1000 and all 13 sessions were removed. The imported audit reproduces those exact useful recipes. All dossier lints are empty and current pack/KG/rubric/runtime/audit bindings match. Limits: Aluat abstracts pastry sheets, and sugar+milk or sugar+vanilla are loose ingredient associations, not complete recipes; this does not claim the five seeds alone cook authentic Cremșnit. The bounded assembly arc remains fair within this association game. Diplomat is excluded and its earlier mechanical screen remains history, not an approved second round.
